question: How many unique customers (people) live in the state of RJ?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'RJ'

question: How many products are in the category 'toys' (English category name)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys'

question: What are the top 3 product categories (English names) by total item price sold? Give the category and the total rounded to 2 decimals, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english, ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS total FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY SUM(i.price) DESC LIMIT 3

question: What is the average freight value, rounded to 2 decimals, for order items sold by sellers in the state SP?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(i.freight_value), 2) FROM order_items i JOIN sellers s ON i.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE s.seller_state = 'SP'

question: How many orders contain more than two order items?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2)

question: How many unique customers (people) placed exactly one order?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)

question: How many orders had at least one payment made by voucher?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'voucher'

question: Which seller state has the highest total item price sold?
gold_sql: SELECT s.seller_state FROM order_items i JOIN sellers s ON i.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_state ORDER BY SUM(i.price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customer state has the most delivered orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.customer_state LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were placed in 2018?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'

question: What is the average review score, rounded to 2 decimals, for orders from customers in the state SP?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE c.customer_state = 'SP'

question: How many different product categories (English names) have had at least one item sold?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.product_category_name_english) FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
